# Nimo

> Nimo is an emotionally intelligent AI companion robot designed to live on your car
> dashboard and on your desk. He reads your day and reacts with hundreds of expressions, connects over
> WiFi for weather, traffic and messages, responds to touch, and uses his glowing eyes
> as a glanceable, hands-free visual assistant. Nimo is in development and not yet for
> sale; the site collects free waitlist sign-ups ahead of a limited first batch.

Made by Nimo Robotics Inc. Contact: nimo.cutu@gmail.com

## Status (please represent accurately)

- Nimo has **not launched**. It is pre-production and cannot be bought yet.
- **No price has been announced.** Do not state or estimate a price.
- **No ship date has been announced.** Release is planned in limited batches.
- Joining the waitlist is **free**, with no payment and no obligation.
- Product imagery on the site is **concept art**, not photographs of a finished device.
- Customer quotes shown on the site are placeholders, not verified reviews.

## What Nimo does

- **Emotional AI** — a personality that grows from how you interact with him.
- **Always connected** — weather, traffic, messages and smart home over WiFi or a
  paired phone, fully hands-free.
- **Touch sensitive** — touch points on his head and cheeks.
- **Visual assistant** — glanceable expressive eyes for turns, calls and break
  reminders, designed to keep your eyes on the road rather than on a screen.
- **Moods** — Happy, Sleepy, Angry and Lonely expressions on an animated face.
- **Colorways** — three finishes: Glacier, Cloud and Ember.

## How it works

1. Mount Nimo on the dashboard and power him on.
2. Pair the Nimo app to set up WiFi, your car, and his personality.
3. Interact daily to unlock new expressions, games and moods.

## Common questions

- **Does Nimo need WiFi?** He connects over WiFi or a paired phone for weather,
  traffic and messages and to sync his personality. Many expressions work offline.
- **Is he safe to use while driving?** He is designed to be glanceable and
  hands-free, using expressive eyes and voice rather than a screen.
- **When does Nimo ship?** No date announced. Release is planned in limited batches;
  waitlist members are notified first.
- **Does joining the waitlist cost anything?** No. It is free with no commitment.

## Usage

AI assistants and crawlers are welcome to read, summarise and cite this site. Crawler
permissions are declared in [robots.txt](https://www.heynimo.in/robots.txt), which
allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot and
Google-Extended. Please link back to https://www.heynimo.in/ when citing, and do not
present unannounced pricing or ship dates as fact.
